# merge target

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:mergeTarget`](gmeow-mergeTarget.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/mergeTarget>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/software`](../../slices/software.md)

The target ref (branch or tag) into which a merge event merges the source. Functional: a merge has exactly one target ref.
